visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with short dark hair tied in pigtails sits securely in a gray car seat. She looks out the window with a curious expression, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and gray leggings. The car interior is visible with clear daylight coming through the windows. (2) The scene shifts to the toddler walking across a blue and gray paved playground area. She is captured in a medium full shot, moving steadily with a focused facial expression. (3) The toddler is seen in a blue bucket swing. A hand occasionally enters the frame to push her. She laughs and smiles brightly as the swing moves towards the camera, providing close-up views of her joyful face. (4) The child climbs the metal stairs of a playground structure. She is viewed from behind, gripping yellow handrails as she ascends step by step. (5) The camera is positioned at the bottom of a red tube slide. The toddler slides down, her face showing excitement and surprise as she emerges from the tunnel. (6) The video concludes with a pink screen featuring a cartoon character and brand text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright and cheerful acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft piano track begins. A female adult voice speaks with high pitch variability and a friendly tone, interacting with a toddler. The toddler responds with soft, high-pitched cooing sounds. (2) The acoustic BGM continues steadily at 120 BPM. Sounds of a light outdoor breeze and the soft rustle of clothing are audible as the female voice narrates the outing. (3) The child's high-arousal laughter and joyful squeals dominate the mix as she plays on a swing. Rhythmic metallic clicks of the swing chain are perceptible under the BGM. (4) Percussive footstep sounds on a metal staircase occur as the child climbs, mixed with encouraging words from the mother. (5) A distinct friction-based sliding sound is heard followed by a loud 'whee' from the child and a cartoon-style bubble pop SFX for emphasis. (6) The BGM concludes with a final melodic resolve as the female voice says a parting phrase.
